title: Example Resale Corp. S-1 resale registration
primaryDocumentText:
FORM S-1
REGISTRATION STATEMENT
Example Resale Corp.
(Exact name of registrant as specified in its charter)

PROSPECTUS SUMMARY
This prospectus relates to the resale from time to time by the selling stockholders named in this prospectus.

THE OFFERING
The selling stockholders may offer and sell up to 5,000,000 shares of common stock. We will not receive any proceeds from the sale of shares by the selling stockholders. We had 18,500,000 shares of common stock issued and outstanding as of May 31, 2026.

SELLING STOCKHOLDERS
Holder Name | Shares Owned Before | Shares Offered | Shares Owned After | Percent After
Alpha Fund LP | 4,000,000 | 3,000,000 | 1,000,000 | 4.9%
Beta Capital LLC | 2,500,000 | 2,000,000 | 500,000 | 2.5%

PLAN OF DISTRIBUTION
The selling stockholders may sell the shares from time to time at market prices, fixed prices, or negotiated prices.

USE OF PROCEEDS
We will not receive proceeds from the resale by the selling stockholders, except for cash exercise of warrants if exercised for cash.

RISK FACTORS
The sale of a substantial number of shares by selling stockholders could depress the market price of our common stock.

DESCRIPTION OF SECURITIES
The registered shares include shares issuable upon exercise of outstanding warrants at an exercise price of $1.25 per share.
